description: This file contains utility functions and constants for CLI operations, including directory setup, status symbols, spinner implementation, and printing functions for user interface feedback.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A CLI spinner for indicating progress, with methods to start, stop, show success/error messages, and update the message.

methods.name: NewSpinner
methods.description: Creates a new spinner instance with a specified message.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the spinner and clears the line.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Stops the spinner and displays a success message.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Stops the spinner and displays an error message.

methods.name: UpdateMessage
methods.description: Updates the spinner message while running.
